description_en: Calls the ActiveFlowLog operation to activate a flow log and start capturing traffic of the specified resource
description_zh: 调用ActiveFlowLog接口启动流日志，启动后开始捕获指定资源的流量
kebab_example: aliyun vpc active-flow-log --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --flow-log-id fl-m5e8vhz2t21sel1nq0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ActiveFlowLog

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the flow log. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh: 流日志所属的地域ID。您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call is successful.

true: The call is successful.
false: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
是否调用成功。

true：调用成功。
false：调用失败
